resources.string: The app stays just as beautiful but runs lighter on old and budget phones

Settings → Appearance → “Low-end device mode”. The looks stay, but live decorations are drawn less often, glass refreshes less often and games use fewer particles - the phone heats less, the battery lasts longer and everything is smoother. In “Auto” it turns on by itself on weak phones.
The file manager has an archiver: create ZIPs with a password and compression level, open archives like folders, extract all or selected files, add and delete files, test integrity.
